lyrics:
[Intro: clean guitar arpeggio, soft organ, room tone]

[Verse 1: deep male baritone, murmured]
Sheets of paper, curled and yellow
Came down easy, one by one
Crayon horses, purple fellows
A house, a tree, a square of sun

[Verse 2: bass and brushed drums enter]
Now the wall's a field of pinholes
Eighteen years of little stars
I could fill them, I could paint it
I just stand here where you are

[Chorus: band rises, voice opening]
All I've got is thumbtack holes
Where your drawings were
Every one a day you handed me
And I said, "That's nice," and stirred
I'd give anything to look again
All I've got is thumbtack holes

[Verse 3: voice rougher, electric guitar in]
Your room still smells like your shampoo
There's a sock behind the door
Your mother's on the phone with you
I can't. I'll call. I'm on the floor.

[Chorus: full band, voice howling]
All I've got is thumbtack holes
Where your drawings were
Every one a day you handed me
And I said, "That's nice," and stirred
I'd give anything to look again
All I've got is thumbtack holes

[Bridge: band crashing, voice at its limit]
I know you're fine! I know it's right!
I know this is the thing we raised you for!
I know! I know!

[Outro: band drops to piano and guitar, wordless vocal, crowd joining]
Doo doo doo, doo doo doo doo
Doo doo doo, doo doo doo doo
(I'm not going to paint it)
Doo doo doo, doo doo doo doo
